CORAM: HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition on the ground that the petitioners/accused No.2 to 5 are already acquitted in C.C No.8606/2021 by the trial Court.
He also filed copy of certified copy of the said judgment.
2. In the light of the same, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn for having become infructuous.
3. In view of the disposal of petition, pending application/s, if any, stands disposed off, as no separate order is required.
